events.titleZh: Norton Street 意大利街头嘉年华
events.summaryZh: 一边尝意大利小吃，一边看现场表演、烹饪示范和汽车展示，孩子还能挑选互动活动。大人也有得逛、有得吃，适合全家慢慢走的一日街头节庆。
events.summaryEn: Share Italian food, enjoy performances and cooking demonstrations, and browse the car displays. Children can join interactive activities while adults explore the street festival too.
events.priceZh: 免费入场；餐饮及部分项目另计
events.priceEn: Free entry; food and some activities extra
events.referenceZh: 主办方活动页，10月23日核实。

linkReview.evidence: Organiser confirms 25 October 2026, 10am-5pm, Norton Street Leichhardt, food, performances, cooking, cars and children's activities. Participating venue confirms free attendance: https://www.theroyalleichhardt.com.au/norton-street-italian-festa

events.titleZh: DanceRites 歌剧院户外舞蹈节
events.summaryZh: 在歌剧院前看原住民及托雷斯海峡岛民团队用舞蹈、语言和歌声讲述文化。全龄适合、无需登记，可挑一段节目欣赏；活动区不允许推车，15岁及以下需成人全程陪同。
events.summaryEn: Watch Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander groups share culture through dance, language and song on the Forecourt. All ages welcome, with no registration; strollers are not permitted in the event area and visitors aged 15 and under need an accompanying adult.
events.timeEn: Saturday 24–Sunday 25 October; site opens 1:30pm, program from 2pm
events.placeEn: Sydney Opera House Forecourt, Bennelong Point NSW
events.mapQuery: Sydney Opera House Forecourt, Bennelong Point NSW
events.referenceZh: Sydney Opera House 节目及入场规定，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Sydney Opera House program and entry conditions, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Venue confirms 24-25 October 2026, Forecourt, opens 1:30pm, program from 2pm, free without registration, all ages. Event footprint prohibits strollers; children aged 15 and under must be accompanied.

events.titleZh: Mosman Encore 街头音乐派对
events.summaryZh: 放学后一起去听现场乐队、逛街头餐摊，孩子可以试试街机、闪粉装饰和喷绘纹身。晚饭和音乐一次安排好，按孩子的精神状态选择停留多久。
events.summaryEn: Make an after-school outing of live bands, street food, arcade games, glitter and airbrush tattoos. Combine dinner and music, staying only as long as your children enjoy it.
events.placeZh: Middle Head Road，Mosman Junction 至 Muston Street
events.placeEn: Middle Head Road, Mosman Junction to Muston Street NSW
events.mapQuery: Middle Head Road and Muston Street, Mosman NSW
events.referenceZh: Mosman Council 场次详情，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Mosman Council session details, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Event-specific council page states Friday 23 October 2026, 5-8:30pm, Middle Head Road between Mosman Junction and Muston Street, free. Live bands, food, arcade games and decoration stalls. Broader Encore overview includes Saturday too; do not infer Saturday hours from Friday details.

events.tagZh: 奥林匹克公园 · 文化节
events.summaryZh: 用现场音乐、舞蹈、文化展示和非洲风味餐摊，安排一次全家都能参与的文化之旅。两份官方页面的开场时间不同，按市议会较晚的11点到访安排更稳妥。
events.summaryEn: Explore African music, dance, cultural displays and food together. Official listings disagree on the opening time; plan from the council's later 11am start.
events.timeEn: Saturday 24 October, 11am–8pm (council); venue lists a 10am start
events.placeEn: Cathy Freeman Park, Sydney Olympic Park NSW
events.priceZh: 捐款票$6，另加订票费；先查看订票页
events.priceEn: $6 donation ticket plus booking fee; check booking page
events.mapQuery: Cathy Freeman Park, Sydney Olympic Park NSW
events.referenceZh: City of Parramatta 与场地方页面，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: City of Parramatta and venue listings, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Council confirms 24 October 2026, 11am-8pm, Cathy Freeman Park, donation ticket $6 plus booking fee, live culture and food. Venue lists 10am-8pm: https://www.sydneyolympicpark.nsw.gov.au/things-to-see-and-do/africultures-festival . Difference disclosed; plan from 11am. Council links official Raisely booking.

events.titleZh: Maroubra 趣味跑与社区嘉年华
events.summaryZh: 想动起来就按组别报名趣味跑，也可以只逛免费的社区庆典，看看表演、餐摊和游乐项目。跑步报名与嘉年华入场是两回事，不参加比赛也能一起过来玩。
events.summaryEn: Enter a suitable fun-run division or simply visit the free community celebration for entertainment, food and amusements. Race registration is separate: families can enjoy Oktoberfest without entering the run.
events.timeZh: 10月25日（周日）7:30–17:00为整日活动范围；比赛及游乐按各自安排
events.timeEn: Sunday 25 October, overall event window 7:30am–5pm; race and amusement schedules differ
events.placeEn: Arthur Byrne Reserve, South Maroubra NSW
events.priceZh: 嘉年华免费入场；趣味跑需付费报名，餐饮及游乐另计
events.priceEn: Free Oktoberfest entry; run registration, food and amusements extra
events.mapQuery: Arthur Byrne Reserve, South Maroubra NSW
events.referenceZh: 主办方及 Randwick Council 活动详情，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Organiser and Randwick Council event details, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Organiser confirms Sunday 25 October 2026 at Arthur Byrne Reserve, family run and community festival. /oktoberfest/ confirms free festival entry and separate food/amusements. Council lists overall 7:30am-5pm, not all ride opening hours: https://www.randwick.nsw.gov.au/community/whats-on/events/community-events/maroubra-fun-run-and-oktoberfest

events.tagZh: 帕拉马塔 · 夜间艺术节
events.summaryZh: 在小巷、花园和屋顶之间找大型艺术装置、听现场音乐、尝街头小吃。本周只剩周五和周六两晚，带孩子可早点到，按官方地图挑几个站点，不必逛到闭场。
events.summaryEn: Find large-scale art, live music and street food between laneways, gardens and rooftops. Only Friday and Saturday remain this week; arrive early with children and choose a few stops from the official map.
events.placeZh: Parramatta CBD 多个小巷及公共空间
events.placeEn: Parramatta CBD, multiple laneways and public spaces NSW
events.referenceZh: City of Parramatta / AT Parramatta，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: City of Parramatta / AT Parramatta, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Official 2026 schedule states Friday 23 and Saturday 24 October 5-10:30pm, free multi-site Parramatta CBD arts/music/food festival. Refreshed final-two-night copy replaces last week's Wednesday/Thursday details; road closures apply.

events.tagZh: 东区海岸 · 户外雕塑展
events.titleZh: Sculpture by the Sea 海边雕塑展
events.summaryZh: 沿 Bondi 至 Tamarama 海岸步道，一起找海景中的雕塑，走累了就折返，不必一次走完全程。户外路段有台阶和人流，带推车先查无障碍路线；周末进城铁路有施工，出发前查交通。
events.summaryEn: Spot sculptures along the Bondi–Tamarama coastal walk and turn back whenever the family needs a break. Steps and crowds affect parts of the route; check accessible options for strollers and weekend rail trackwork before travelling.
events.timeZh: 10月16日–11月2日；户外建议白天；Marks Park 室内展10:00–18:00
events.timeEn: 16 October–2 November; visit outdoors in daylight; indoor display at Marks Park 10am–6pm
events.placeZh: Bondi–Tamarama 海岸步道及 Marks Park
events.placeEn: Bondi–Tamarama coastal walk and Marks Park NSW
events.referenceZh: 主办方及 Transport for NSW，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Organiser and Transport for NSW, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Organiser confirms free Bondi-Tamarama exhibition 16 October-2 November 2026. https://visit.sculpturebythesea.com/ gives Sculpture Inside at Marks Park daily 10am-6pm. https://transportnsw.info/events/2026/10/sculpture-by-sea warns of crowds and 24-25 October rail trackwork. Daylight visit is editorial advice, not an asserted outdoor gate time.

events.tagZh: 奥林匹克公园 · 互动展览
events.titleZh: 哈利波特展：走进魔法世界
events.summaryZh: 一起看电影服装道具、体验魁地奇互动，再找熟悉的魔法细节。建议5岁起，预留约60–90分钟；展内不允许推车，从 Olympic Boulevard 进入。
events.summaryEn: Explore film costumes, props and Quidditch interactions together. Recommended for ages 5+; allow around 60–90 minutes. Strollers are not permitted inside; enter from Olympic Boulevard.
events.timeEn: Mon/Thu 10am–5:30pm; Fri noon–7:30pm; weekends 9am–6:30pm; closed Tue/Wed. Use your booked session
events.placeEn: Paddington Pavilion, Sydney Showground, Olympic Park NSW
events.priceZh: 成人定时票$33起（含费用）；儿童票按场次
events.priceEn: Timed adult tickets from $33 incl. fees; child prices vary
events.mapQuery: Paddington Pavilion, Sydney Showground, Sydney Olympic Park NSW
events.referenceZh: 展览悉尼官方页面，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Official Sydney exhibition page, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Official Sydney page confirms now open at Paddington Pavilion via Olympic Boulevard, weekly hours shown, timed adults from $33 including fees, ages 5+ recommended, 60-90 minute visit, no strollers. Summer dates through January 2027 but exact final day not stated. Conflicting free-child and last-entry snippets are not repeated; use dated ticket calendar.

moreLinks.titleZh: Gymea Village 街头嘉年华 · 10月25日9:00–16:00

linkReview.evidence: Organiser detail page confirms 25 October 2026, 9am-4pm, Gymea Bay Road, street stalls, rides, performances and family activities. Application closure concerns stallholders, not public cancellation.

Council confirms Tuesday 27 October 2026, 10am-noon, Mosman Square and Village Green Spit Junction, free, reptiles, art, drums, rides and bubbles. Festival overview describes young children, so placed in More.

moreLinks.titleZh: The Rocks 周末市集 · 10月24–25日10:00–17:00
moreLinks.sourceZh: The Rocks 官方市集详情

linkReview.evidence: Actual market detail page, not generic What's On. Confirms Saturday/Sunday 10am-5pm, Jack Mundey Place, Playfair and George Streets, makers, food, art and music. This week's weekend is 24-25 October; stallholder FAQ corroborates regular schedule.
